description: A dark olive wool apron dress with restrained ochre woven borders along the straps, sides and hem and two modest round metal shoulder brooches, over a cream linen shift with elbow-length sleeves and a moderately open curved neckline. A red-and-cream patterned woven belt has long tasselled ends; the full layered skirt leaves brown leather shoes visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
